Project Deep Brush, developed by senior research scientist Iliyan Georgiev, introduces a context-aware digital brush that paints seamlessly across uneven surfaces such as walls, fabric and skin. Instead of applying text, paint or objects as flat, separate layers, the tool automatically bends and conforms them to the scene’s natural geometry and physics. Automating this process eliminates a task that would otherwise require significant time and advanced manual skill. #adobemax #projectdeepbrush #software #adobe #digitalbrush
